notes:
{援助|えんじょ} means aid or assistance, typically on a larger scale — government programs, international aid, or organizational support rather than everyday personal help.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {援助|えんじょ}する: to provide aid
- {援助|えんじょ}を{受|う}ける: to receive aid
- {援助|えんじょ}を{求|もと}める: to seek aid
- {援助|えんじょ}を{行|おこな}う: to carry out aid

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {経済|けいざい}{援助|えんじょ}: economic aid
- {軍事|ぐんじ}{援助|えんじょ}: military aid
- {人道|じんどう}{援助|えんじょ}: humanitarian aid
- {開発|かいはつ}{援助|えんじょ}: development aid
- {資金|しきん}{援助|えんじょ}: financial aid

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {支援|しえん}: support (broader, also used for personal or emotional support)
- {助|たす}け: help (everyday, informal)
- {援助|えんじょ}: more formal and institutional in tone
